items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury sustained in-game.
items.why: Ankle injury during game; ruled out.
items.implication: No further production this week; monitor severity for ROS.
items.opportunity: Target/route share boost for other MIN WRs/TE.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled out with rib injury/strain; full eval Monday.
items.why: Rib injury after being carted; strain per Rapoport.
items.implication: No more this week; painful injury, monitor ROS.
items.opportunity: Targets for other SF pass-catchers like Kittle/Samuel.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury.
items.implication: Sit; elevate Jets backup RBs for remaining snaps/carries.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs due to knee injury; coach Hafley not optimistic, sounds major.
items.why: Knee injury in-game then downgraded; coach concern for major issue.
items.implication: Sit immediately; check handcuffs/waivers for MIA RBs ROS.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining Dolphins backs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looking good; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout successful; team decision after not counting on him.
items.implication: Startable if rostered, though limited; monitor snaps/targets.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if plays significant role despite hamstring.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated right thumb; MRI tomorrow, likely to miss time per coach Bowles.
items.implication: Likely multi-week; impacts TB pass-catchers ROS.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and adjusted TB WR/RB usage.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF; also Broncos WR Marvin Mims inactive.
items.implication: Sit; boost for other LAR WRs like Adams.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes for Davante Adams and LAR pass-catchers.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut vs. Saints.
items.why: Expected and confirmed active after limited practices.
items.implication: Must-start TE if rostered; high opportunity in debut.

items.text: Zay Flowers active: risky but if active for Baltimore, active for me. Start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active confirmation; prefers over Bateman despite risk/limited.
items.implication: Start Flowers in fantasy if available.
items.opportunity: Even limited, better than alternatives in BAL WR corps.

items.text: Actives include Steelers RB Jaylen Warren and WR Michael Pittman (foot, expected); also Bills DJ Moore and Keon Coleman.
items.why: Expected to play and confirmed active.
items.implication: Startable; Warren volume potential, Pittman/Moore roles intact.
items.opportunity: Carries for Warren; targets for Pittman/Moore.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Jets WRs: Garrett Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Jamaal Pritchett, Sterling Shepard, Malik McLain. Expect TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide work.
items.why: Finger injury; confirmed expected inactive per Fowler.
items.implication: Wilson primary; depth WRs and Sadiq elevated opportunity.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes for Wilson and Jets WR/TE depth post-Mitchell.

items.text: ETR projecting Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring) for now, late swap Bateman/Andrews in mind; Moore in but limited, Mitchell out. No early info on those.
items.why: Team not counting on him; conservative projs pending workout.
items.implication: DFS late swap prep; Flowers later active changed this.
items.conflict: Later confirmed ACTIVE by Schefter/Rapoport; Berry starts if active.

items.text: Sunday AM summary: Flowers GTD (not counting on), Spears hopeful GTD; Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson, Bagent.
items.implication: Baseline for projections; many expected cleared later.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop, Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup and prop; feed him.
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone volume vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches, 15% target share both games, RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share last week with Collins out; IND allows 4th-most yds to TEs. 10 Facts notes 30% routes targeted.
items.why: Elevated role vs good TE matchup; usage data.
items.opportunity: High target share with Collins out.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps, 5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/game to RBs. 10 Facts: Henderson 65% snaps post-fumble.
items.why: Reduced role + tough matchup; Henderson opportunity noted.
